name: Kurumsal A? Topolojisi ve G?venlik Mimarisi
summary: A cybersecurity company with an Istanbul HQ, a Sivas SOC and R&D base, an Ankara training academy, and a Dubai trade office. Each site deploys a 2-node Active-Passive FortiGate HA cluster (FGCP) with Dual-ISP SD-WAN failover, IPsec hub tunnels terminating in Sivas, role-based ZTNA enforced with SAML 2.0 SSO and FIDO2 hardware MFA, three-layer monitoring (Wazuh/FortiAnalyzer with 90d/1y/5y WORM retention, NetFlow/SPAN, and Sysmon/Wazuh EDR), automated 3-2-1 encrypted backups, monthly Mature firmware patching, and KVKK/GDPR/Law 5651 privacy controls.

remoteAccess.note: Inter-branch traffic runs over encrypted AES-256-GCM IPsec VPN / SD-WAN tunnels terminating at Sivas hub (10.20.0.0/16), while remote personnel authenticate via role-based FortiClient ZTNA enforced with SAML 2.0 SSO, phishing-resistant FIDO2 hardware MFA (no TOTP), and device posture checks: SOC analysts -> 10.20.20.0/25; Red Team -> 10.10.40.0/27 & 10.40.20.0/27; R&D -> 10.20.10.0/26, 10.10.50.0/28 & 10.40.40.0/28; IT/Network Admins -> 10.x.99.0/28 OOB VLANs via JIT PAM bastion; Management/Accounting/Sales -> cloud ERP/CRM ZTNA proxy; Interns -> public cloud lab portal only (zero 10.x access).

monitoring.siem: Wazuh SIEM and FortiAnalyzer in Sivas (10.20.20.0/25) ingest logs from all 4 branches over IPsec (TCP 1514/1515, UDP 514); sFlow/NetFlow on switches/firewalls plus SPAN mirror ports with Wireshark/Zeek on Red Team VLANs; Sysmon and Wazuh EDR agents on endpoints. Retention: 90d hot NVMe, 1y warm compressed, 5y immutable SHA-256 WORM cold archive per Law No. 5651 & KVKK/GDPR.
monitoring.owner: 24/7 SOC team in Sivas (65 analysts) with automated SOAR playbooks, daily 03:00 TRT AES-256 encrypted 3-2-1 config backups (RTO < 15m, RPO < 24h), and monthly 3rd-Sunday 02:00-05:00 TRT hitless FGCP rolling FortiOS Mature firmware patching (CVSS >= 9.0 patched within 24h).
monitoring.alertSink: Wazuh SIEM & FortiAnalyzer SOC consoles in Sivas (10.20.20.0/25) with SOAR incident response.
monitoring.appVsSecurity: Three-layer separation: Layer 1 firewall policy/session logs, Layer 2 network telemetry (NetFlow/sFlow & SPAN), Layer 3 host EDR/XDR (Sysmon/Wazuh) with KVKK/GDPR PII masking and SSL DPI privacy exemptions for banking, healthcare, and HR portals.

cveWatch.note: CVSS 9.8 argument injection RCE; patched PHP runtime across web/academy portals, enforced WAF virtual patching, and verified zero exploitation indicators in Wazuh SIEM.
CVSS 9.8 out-of-bounds write; upgraded all 8 FortiGate units to FortiOS 7.4.x Mature and disabled legacy SSL-VPN on WAN interfaces in favor of ZTNA + FIDO2 MFA.
CVSS 9.8 authentication bypass; disabled WAN HTTP/HTTPS admin interfaces, isolated management to OOB VLAN 99, and applied Mature firmware patch.
CVSS 9.8 missing authentication; restricted TCP/541 to IPsec hub tunnels and OOB VLAN 99 only, upgraded build, and enabled fgfm anomaly detection in Wazuh.
CVSS 8.1 Security Fabric auth bypass; applied FortiOS Mature security patch, restricted admin trusted-hosts, and enabled SIEM alerting.
